title: The kbmon-pane mod's refresh in flight when /clear fires sets lastAlerts after the reset, so the new session gets no receipt until the alert set changes
goal: A refresh that started before a session reset does not record its alert rows as seen after the reset, so the new session's next refresh appends the receipt

run: import sys;t=open(".claude/skills/kbmon-pane/hooks/register.tsx",encoding="utf-8").read();sys.exit(0 if ("generation" in t or "epoch" in t) else 1)

repro_reason: the mod runs only inside an interactive Claude Code session; no headless command races a refresh against /clear, so the repro reads that the refresh checks a generation or epoch counter before it records lastAlerts
